steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can't hold it any longer! Their brains are tougher than my pipe! How the *** can we defeat them?! Hecate! Come give me a hand!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's too dangerous here. Chief, come this way!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't just leave me here!
Hecate grabs your hand and pulls you into a dark alley.
After coming across a dumpster, she tosses you in and closes the lid. A foul smell envelops you, almost knocking you out.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay here. Let us deal with the enemy.

To be slain by a Corruptor, or choke to death from garbage stench? The difference no longer matters to you. You instinctively reach out to push open the lid. The light shines through, illuminating a snow-white limb by your side.
Lying next to you inside the dumpster is a beautiful young maid.
Her fair, slender limbs are strewn with scars, and her skin is spotted with stains. The maid's eyes are wide open, lifeless and cold.
You restrain your panic and try to back away slowly from the maid's body. However, your hand sinks into the garbage and triggers a landslide inside the dumpster.
The body of the maid lands in your arms.
She is hard and heavy, ringing out metallic echoes whenever she hits something. The moment she touches you, her pupils light up.
You can't help but edge closer and observe the girl under the dim light. Her body has not yet decayed, nor did she have even a whiff of foul odor.
The battle stains splattered across her face made her wide-open eyes appear even sadder.
You can't help but reach out to wipe the stains from her face. The minute you touch her, you hear a whirring sound, and her pupils light up.

steps.speaker: Broken Maid
steps.content: Lo-lowering co-contamination. Clearing contamination. Removing barrier. Retrieving the body.

steps.speaker: Broken Maid
steps.content: Reboot. Rebooting system. System reboot failed. Initializing the system. Deleting memory... Work, fight... co... coffee...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content:
What's happening?!
Is it a Sinner reaction?

steps.speaker: Broken Maid
steps.content:
Protect... Ma... Mary... Mary... Ma... ry...
I'm... so... rry...
Some liquid drips past her cheeks. Her joints twist and creak as she suddenly jerks up. Her head hits the top of the dumpster with a loud metallic bang.

steps.speaker: Broken Maid
steps.content: Initialization is complete. Reboot successful.

steps.speaker: Broken Maid
steps.content:
Hello, A.I. Maid III, <color=#fb9259>Labyrinth</color>, at your service.
Would you like me to start cleaning, Master?
